name: sandtable-rig-3A2T
description: Sandtable exercise rig, room scale: three anchors on a 3.6 x 4.4 m rectangle (the same proportions as the exercise floor, so the default registration is about 1:9.8), two tags. T1 is Engine 1, T2 is the rescue team. The tags are parked; the Sandtable server moves them with /sim/teleport (storyboard autopilot, followers, UI drag), so positions still pass through the kit's noisy ranging and solver.
